text:
Sam (Finance): BrightMetrics (UK) just got paid and AP tells me they were withholding 30% because vendor submitted a W-9. Vendor is UK-based — can someone confirm correct treatment and next steps?
Oliver (AP): Payment went out today for INV-BM-2026-15 (GBP 9,000). AP defaulted to 30% backup withholding since the uploaded tax doc was a W-9. We held GBP 2,700 and wired the net. Vendor emailed asking Redwood to gross-up the shortfall.
BrightMetrics (VendorBot): Vendor record: BrightMetrics Ltd, country=GB, VAT=GB999888777, bank=HSBC UK, tax_docs: w9_brightmetrics_2026-06-14.pdf uploaded by vendor. Vendor message excerpt: "We mistakenly uploaded W-9. We are a UK entity; please reverse deduct and pay the gross or reimburse."
Harpreet (Tax): We need correct documentation. For a non-US entity, W-8BEN-E is required to show foreign status and claim any treaty benefits. If services are performed outside US, generally not US-source and not subject to US withholding; but without W-8BEN-E on file at payment date, payer may be required to withhold.
Kelsey (Legal): Also check the SOW/contract. Does it obligate Redwood to gross-up withheld taxes? If contract silent, vendors are typically responsible for their tax liabilities. Gross-ups require explicit clause or exec sign-off + budget.
Sam (Finance): Vendor claims services were delivered from UK and wants gross-up to make them whole. They say this was an AP portal error. They prefer a reimbursement wire rather than credit.
Harpreet (Tax): Process options: (1) If BrightMetrics uploads a correctly completed W-8BEN-E with an effective date before the payment, we can potentially refund the withheld amount or issue a credit, but we must coordinate with US tax advisor and the mechanics depend on timing. (2) If they cannot provide a valid W-8BEN-E, withholding stands. (3) Gross-up is discretionary and requires Legal + CFO approval.
Oliver (AP): Practical concern: money already wired net. If we refund, we need a vendor request in writing and a verification of the corrected W-8, then AP will either issue a separate reimbursement or apply credit to next invoice.
BrightMetrics (VendorBot): Vendor uploaded w8bene_brightmetrics_2026-06-15.pdf (pending review) and sent written request: "Please reimburse GBP 2,700 withheld on INV-BM-2026-15. We provided W-8BEN-E after payment; services performed in UK."
Harpreet (Tax): I'll review W-8BEN-E. If it properly documents foreign status and is effective to cover the payment date, tax may allow refund. We need vendor to confirm in writing: 1) they request refund of withheld amount (reference invoice number and amounts); 2) confirm place of performance (UK) and effective date range; 3) state they received net payment and request reimbursement, not additional gross-up.
Sam (Finance): Draft reply to vendor (please copy & send):
```
Hi <BrightMetrics AP>,

Thanks for uploading the W-8BEN-E. To process a refund of the GBP 2,700 withheld on INV-BM-2026-15, please reply confirming: (1) you request a refund/reimbursement of GBP 2,700 referencing INV-BM-2026-15; (2) all services covered by that invoice were performed outside the United States (in the UK); and (3) you authorize Redwood to issue a reimbursement wire to the bank on file (or apply a credit to your next invoice  please indicate preference).

Note: Refunds are subject to verification of the W-8BEN-E and tax advisor confirmation. If the W-8BEN-E does not substantiate foreign status for the payment date, we may be unable to refund. Redwood does not gross-up withholding unless contractually required or approved by Finance + Legal.

Thanks,
Sam  Redwood Finance
```
Kelsey (Legal): Add sentence: "If you request reimbursement, please confirm that you will not pursue any further claims against Redwood related to this withholding event once refund is issued."
BrightMetrics (VendorBot): Vendor replied: "We confirm and request reimbursement of GBP 2,700 for INV-BM-2026-15. Services performed in the UK. We authorize reimbursement to bank on file and confirm we will not pursue further claims once reimbursed. Signed: AP Dept."
Harpreet (Tax): W-8BEN-E looks valid (entity foreign status, signed 2026-06-15). I'll run this by external tax counsel to confirm refund mechanics. If counsel approves, Finance/AP can issue reimbursement wire or CM depending on vendor preference.
Oliver (AP): Vendor requests wire. If tax OKs, I'll prepare reimbursement wire and require vendor to sign receipt acknowledgement. Also need a vendor credit note if they prefer credit.
Sam (Finance): CFO approval needed for one-off reimbursement policy exception. Kelsey, can Legal confirm indemnity language?
Kelsey (Legal): I'll prepare a short reimbursement settlement letter and loop in CFO for approval. Also confirm contract review: no gross-up clause found.
Harpreet (Tax): Note for records: log event as "tax form correction -> refund pending" and attach original W-9, W-8BEN-E, vendor written request, and vendor reply. This will be necessary if IRS inquiries arise.
Sam (Finance): OK next steps: 1) Legal drafts settlement letter; 2) Tax confirms refund permissibility with counsel; 3) CFO approves reimbursement; 4) AP issues wire and collects signed receipt. I'll update thread when steps complete.
Oliver (AP): Holding additional BrightMetrics payments until this is closed.
Kelsey (Legal): Drafting letter now. Will ping CFO.
Harpreet (Tax): Reached out to tax counsel; expecting reply by COB tomorrow.
Sam (Finance): Thanks all. Will keep this thread updated. :white_check_mark:
